reviews.text: I’ve been taking these Vitamin Village Women’s Probiotics daily, and they’re so easy to fit into my routine. The powder stick format makes it super convenient to take on the go without needing water, and the flavor is pleasant. It’s been a great addition for maintaining daily gut and inner wellness!
reviews.zh: 我每日都食 Vitamin Village 女士益生菌，好容易就融入咗我嘅日常。粉條裝令隨時隨地食都好方便，唔使用水，味道都好好。佢係我維持每日腸道同內在健康嘅好補充！

reviews.text: This is my second order. Since I was born I have had very very slow digestion to the point I am having to have a second round of tests done - but these have made such a difference to my digestion and bathroom habits. With these my digestion has become much more regular when I use it along side specific things in my daily diet as well as working on assisting my muscles with very gentle exercise and massage. These have been a game changer for me and in my situation they helped very quickly but I absolutely MUST take one every single morning before I eat or drink anything else. My slow digestion comes from a medical condition I was born with so if they can be so helpful to me and I haven’t even finished my first order then I think they are worth trying for anyone who wants to focus on digestive health. These will most likely stay a permanent part of my health and wellness routine.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次訂。我由出世開始腸胃蠕動就非常非常慢，慢到而家要再做第二輪檢查——但係呢啲產品對我嘅消化同排便習慣有好大改善。配合日常飲食入面特定嘅嘢，再加上非常溫和嘅運動同按摩去幫助肌肉，我嘅消化已經變得更加規律。呢啲產品對我嚟講係一個大突破，喺我嘅情況下，佢哋好快就見效，不過我每朝食或者飲任何嘢之前，一定要食一粒。我腸胃蠕動慢係由我出世嗰陣就有嘅醫學問題引起嘅，所以如果佢哋對我咁有幫助，而我連第一次訂嘅都未食完，我諗任何想注重腸胃健康嘅人都值得試吓。呢啲產品好大可能會成為我健康護理日常嘅長期一部分。

reviews.text: Purchased this because it said female wellness, and so far so good, towards my period I suffered with itchiness but this time round it’s been quiet 💃💃and drum roll please no constipation!!! This is definitely a probiotic I will be repurchasing going forward. Hope this review helps someone in my boat.

reviews.text: I'm gonna be honest. For the past two years I'm been having intimate issues. I was itching a lot. I took 2 tests at a laboratory but nothing was wrong. So I took matters into my hands. I bought this product, some postbiotics, night enzymes, and lactobacyllus. The itching almost completely disappeared, and it hasn't been even a month since I started taking them. in the results of my last test it shows that my intimate situation is literally perfet. So I think that this product is definitely a YES, because I saw the results.

reviews.text: I am very satisfied with the service provided. Everything was handled professionally and efficiently from start to finish. Overall, it was a positive experience and I would definitely recommend it to others. I would be happy to use this service again in the future.
